concepts.name: quint model
concepts.definition: A .qnt file stating a system's state and the actions that change it, beside the spec whose bullets prove its properties; a bullet names it, or its folder's one model is read.

concepts.name: quint property
concepts.definition: A boolean definition of a quint model a bullet proves with via: [quint] or [quint run]: it must hold in every state quint reaches, or the bullet fails with the states that break it.

rejected.because: the abbreviation reads as a test helper; say the property

concepts.name: bounded model check
concepts.definition: What [quint] adds over simulation: Apalache checks every behaviour of the model up to a number of steps, a bound and not every reachable state; it needs a Java runtime, and without one the bullet is not run.
